::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 27th 1889  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Girton College Cambridge, Yonge IV 11
:::

Dear [Mr Innes](people/person_744.qmd)

Thanks for the [cheque](organizations/other_160.qmd). I think it is a very good thing to cheapen [Womankind](cmy_books/cmybook_115.qmd), especially as it is getting a start through the [Mothers’ Union](organizations/other_31.qmd) taking it up. It will also be well to have [New Ground](cmy_books/cmybook_68.qmd) at 2s  [Mr Scarth](people/person_1272.qmd) of the Waterside Mission is very anxious to have [Friday’s Child](other_books/otherbook_1068.qmd) published separately for the sake of the sailors. I believe [Miss Crompton](people/person_390.qmd)[^2] has been urged to write to you about it and I hope you will do it.  She is singularly unambitious

Yours truly

C M Yonge

---

[^2]: Frances Crompton, author of *Friday's Child*, was one of Innes's authors.
